profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ Ancestry
profile.summary:
Seasoned Back-End Software Engineer with a solid background in designing and implementing robust RESTful services. 

Currently specializing in Java, Spring Boot, and AWS, I have a strong track record of delivering projects on time and within budget. 

With experience in financial systems, I am well-versed in working under the constraints of PCI and SOX governance. 

My ability to adapt to industry changes and tackle any task at hand sets me apart as a versatile and dedicated professional.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Payment Services
Directly working with and building, services facilitating payments of all types (PCI/CreditCard, Paypal, Direct Debit etc), through Ancestry's Subscription services.
Migration of services from traditional datacenters to AWS.
Standing up and maintaining payment storage and authorization stacks in AWS.

positions.title: Application Development Manager
positions.description:
Managed Front End Development at Maverik Basecamp. 
     Developed and managed development, of front end solutions for Customer Service, HR, Retail, Marketing and Maverik.com. 
     Enhanced back end Spring services for the front end to make use of, delivering value to all of Maverik's departments.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Heavy Java & Spring Framework service creation, for front end developers to use. 
* In house software facilitating the processing of retail transactions, giving adventure clubcard points to card holders.
* 3rd party payment service integration via (JP Morgan Chase).
* Legacy intranet php development
* Ground up development of a Java Spring Framework stack facilitating integration with Ultimate Software (HR) via SOAP, and legacy Oracle HR software. This facilitated everything from payroll to granting access to various systems based on a users role with the company.
* Custom retail collections software, leveraging Certegy.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development primarily for Credit Union Core Processing and Online Banking.

     Worked primarily on the Online Banking product (web and mobile) that is accessible to the members of numerous credit unions across the United States. Developing anything from SSO's to OFX servers to AS400 System Monitoring web-apps and everything else in-between. 
     Before leaving, I created codebase for the brand new Android app, to be branded for and sold as an add on feature to the Credit Unions that were customers of CMC.
     I helped custom brand/skin the online banking product to match credit unions main websites, providing a seamless transition between homepage and online banking.

Android online apps that my code and graphics are still found in : https://play.google.com/store/apps/developer?id=Computer%20Marketing%20Corporation&hl=en
